relationships.note: First 2 chars of GSTIN are the state code.
Each event row has a user_id and an event_name.
PAN is 10 chars (AAAAA9999A); GSTIN is 15 and embeds a PAN at positions 3-12. Length + gstin_checksum separate them.
CIN is 21 chars starting with L/U; GSTIN is 15 starting with a 2-digit state code.
CIN is 21 chars starting with L/U; PAN is 10 chars ending in a letter.
Udyam is UDYAM-XX-00-0000000; PAN is 10 alphanumerics.
IFSC is 11 chars with 0 at position 5 (e.g. HDFC0001234); SWIFT/BIC is 8 or 11 chars with a 2-letter ISO country at 5-6.
IBAN starts with a 2-letter country code + 2 check digits and passes mod-97; Indian account numbers are all digits.
IBAN passes mod-97 and starts with a country code; wallet addresses are base58/hex and 26-62 chars.
SAC codes are 6 digits starting with 99; HSN chapters run 01-98.
GST state codes are 2 digits 01-38; PIN codes are 6 digits.
GST state codes are 2 digits 01-38; PIN codes are 6 digits starting 1-9.
pin_code is the India-specific 6-digit PIN; postal_code is the generic international form. Prefer pin_code when every value is 6 digits starting 1-9.
GST rates are a fixed value set (0, 0.25, 3, 5, 12, 18, 28); a generic percentage is any 0-100 value.
Probabilities lie in 0-1; percentages in 0-100. A column entirely within 0-1 is a probability.
score_percent needs a score/marks/result header; percentage is the generic form.
transaction_amount needs a txn/transaction header; amount is the generic form.
claim_amount needs a claim header; amount is the generic form.
donation_amount needs a donation/gift header; amount is the generic form.
premium_amount needs a premium header; amount is the generic form.
benefit_amount needs a benefit header; amount is the generic form.
unit_cost needs a cost header; market_price needs a price/market header.
fare_amount needs a fare header; sale_price needs a sale/price header.
Invoice numbers carry INV/invoice prefixes or headers; order ids carry order/ord.
purchase_order_id needs a PO/purchase header; order_id is the generic sales-order form.
order_id is an identifier (high cardinality, no arithmetic); transaction_amount is a numeric measure. SQL type separates them.
customer_id needs a customer/cust header; user_id needs user/uid. Both are opaque identifiers.
employee_id needs an emp/employee/staff header; user_id needs user/uid.
session_id needs a session/sess header and is typically higher-cardinality than user_id.
uuid requires the 8-4-4-4-12 hex shape on every value; record_id is any row identifier.
request_id needs a request/req/trace header; uuid is by shape alone.
district_neighbourhood needs a district/neighbourhood/locality header; city needs city/town.
state_region needs a state/region/province header; city needs city/town. Value cardinality is lower for states.
country_name values match the ISO country-name list; state_region values do not.
ISO codes are exactly 2 uppercase letters; country names are words.
iso_datetime values carry a time component (T or HH:MM); iso_date values are YYYY-MM-DD only.
Milliseconds are 13 digits; seconds are 10 digits.
date_of_birth needs a dob/birth header and values decades in the past; iso_date is the generic form.
hire_date needs a hire/joining/start header; iso_date is the generic form.
Card numbers pass Luhn and are 13-19 digits; E.164 phones start with + and are at most 15 digits.
ssn requires the 3-2-4 US shape; national_id is any government identifier.
passport_number needs a passport header; national_id needs national/aadhaar/id.
IPv6 values contain colons; IPv4 values are dotted quads.
URLs start with a scheme (http/https); emails contain a single @ and no scheme.
JWTs are three base64url segments separated by dots; API keys are single tokens.
api_key needs an api/key header; credential_secret is the generic secret/token/password form.
MAC addresses are six hex pairs separated by : or -; device_id is any device identifier.
HSN codes are 4/6/8 digits only; SKUs are mixed alphanumerics.
inventory_quantity needs a stock/inventory/on_hand header; quantity is the generic form.
produced_quantity needs a produced/output header; quantity is the generic form.
manager_id needs a manager/supervisor/reports_to header; employee_id needs emp/employee.
vendor_name needs a vendor/supplier/party header; person_name needs name/person/contact.
host_name needs a host header; person_name is the generic form.
manager_name needs a manager/supervisor header; person_name is the generic form.
order_status needs an order header; payment_status needs a payment/pay header. Value sets differ (paid/unpaid vs shipped/delivered).
payment_mode is the India-specific value set (UPI/NEFT/RTGS/IMPS); payment_method is the generic form (card/cash/wallet).
claim_status needs a claim header; ticket_status needs a ticket/case header.
Longitude ranges -180..180; latitude -90..90. A column with any |value| > 90 is longitude.
humidity is bounded 0-100 with a humidity/rh header; temperature needs a temp header and may be negative.
probability is bounded 0-1; risk_score needs a risk header and may use any scale.
NPS is -100..100 or 0..10 with an nps header; CSAT needs a csat/satisfaction header.
release_year needs a release/published header; calendar_year is the generic year form.
publication_year needs a publication/published header; calendar_year is the generic year form.
